description: Free Irish VAT format and check-letter precheck on your number, not a demo. Local validation only: no registration/company verification or payment authorization. 20 attempts per UTC day per IP, shared with REST. Invalid MCP arguments count when they reach tools/call; malformed protocol messages do not. No wallet required. A valid format can optionally continue to paid live EU VIES check_vat, only after explicit spending approval; invalid numbers must be corrected first.
name: precheck_vat
